_meta.harvest_notes: All values transcribed verbatim from live northsydney.nsw.gov.au pages and official council PDFs on 2026-07-30. No values guessed. Meter rates confirmed against raw HTML heading 'Parking meter rates (including GST) 2026-27'. Per-street numeric time limits (1P/2P/4P) are NOT published in machine-readable form by the council; they exist only on physical street signs and on image-based per-area map PDFs.
_meta.access_notes: No authentication, Cloudflare or bot-detection encountered. All pages and PDFs fetched successfully over plain HTTPS.

meter_rates_2026_27.sub_hour_rule_verbatim: Parking for periods of less than one hour will be charged at a pro rata rate.

operating_hours.verbatim: Daytime metered parking hours are 8.30am to 6pm and evening metered parking hours are from 6pm to midnight.

demand_areas.definition_verbatim: Data gathered from regular traffic studies and parking surveys have enabled Council to determine three Parking Demand Areas within the parking meter zones.

areas.High: North Sydney CBD and Alfred Street South (Fitzroy Street to the Harbour Bridge)
areas.Medium: North Sydney CBD shoulder area – Crows Nest, St Leonards, Milsons Point and Kirribilli areas

demand_area_map_pdf.format: Image/colour-coded map (per-street demand tier shown graphically, not as text). Full street-name list extracted to meter-rates-demand-map.txt

infrastructure.verbatim: Our area has 114 parking meters and 177 Touch N Go boxes.
infrastructure.payment: Council's parking meters, Touch N Gos and the PayStay app are Orikan.

public_holidays.summary_verbatim: Fees apply to some parking meters on public holidays.
operate_when: When parking signs do not state any days of the week
When a sign states 'and public holidays'
public_holidays.priority_rule_verbatim: Street signs take priority over parking information displayed on the maps or parking meters.

maps.note_verbatim: Bays 7, 8 & 9 are Disabled Parking on Sundays & public holidays

time_limits.meter_max_stay: Not published. The meter rates page states no maximum-stay time limit for meters; sub-hour parking is pro rata.
time_limits.resident_permit_exemption_verbatim: Resident Parking Permit - a permit that exempts the vehicle noted on the permit, from the time limit shown on the parking control signs that designate the resident parking area. (Policy s3.1)
time_limits.visitor_permit_exemption_verbatim: Visitor Parking Permits - exempt the bearer from time limits and/or meter parking fees for one day only in the parking area written on the front of the Permit where parking is signposted “Permit Holders Excepted”. (Policy s3.2)
time_limits.numeric_limits_finding: The council does NOT publish per-street numeric time limits (e.g. 1P/2P/4P) in any machine-readable form on these pages. Time limits are stated only on physical parking-control street signs and are depicted graphically on the 33 per-area image map PDFs. No numeric time-limit value was fabricated.

resident_permit_zones.structure_verbatim: three resident parking zones (A, B, C) subdivided into 33 Resident Parking Areas; a permit is only valid for the area the residence is situated within.
permit_formats: Shared permit (physical, shareable between two residents of same dwelling, from 7 September 2004)
resident_permit_zones.zone_to_areas_source_verbatim: Policy s4.1 Zone A includes Parking Areas 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,13,16,20,21,23 and 27; s4.2 Zone B includes 10,12,19,22,28,29 and 32; s4.3 Zone C includes 11,14,15,17,18,24,25,26,30,31 and 33.

resident_permit_entitlements.note: Maximum permits by property type and zone (before subtracting off-street spaces). Confirmed against Policy s4.

resident_permit_fees_2026_27.note: Fees reduce ~25% each quarter through the permit year (Apr–Mar). Pensioners with an eligible card receive 50% discount.

eligibility: Permanent residents of North Sydney Council area
visitor_permit.validity: One day only; day of use scratched off; display left of front windscreen; valid only where signposted 'Permit Holders Excepted'
visitor_permit.not_valid_for: Caravans, trailers, or vehicles exceeding 3 tonnes

downloaded_and_parsed.name: Public holidays meters - Milsons Point & Kirribilli

enumerated_not_downloaded.name: Doctor / care worker permit application form

resident_parking_area_maps.note: 33 per-area image-map PDFs (Areas 01-33; Area 23 has no standalone map file but exists in Zone A). Numeric time limits appear graphically on these maps only.
